q:
I will get 14 weeks paid maternity leave and my wish is to take 3 more months of unpaid leave. After 6 months (more or less) I would return to work part-time (50 %).

My husband will get two weeks of paid leave and will probably take another 2 weeks of vacation. Then he will return to work at 80% or 90%. On the days that we both work, our parents will look after our baby.
cx: First pregnancy, fourth month, plan already discussed with her boss.

q: Technically, we could afford it if I worked less than 50 %, but I really like my job and the team and financial independence is important to me.
